name: Item Pedestal
description: An item spawned internally by the game rather than directly created as an object.

fields.name: Item Type
fields.description: Selects the item displayed by the pedestal.

6.name: Fire Rod
6.description: Item stand contains a Fire Rod.

fields.name: Switch
fields.description: Controls whether the pedestal enters the next state after the item interaction.

fields.name: Tile Layer
fields.description: Selects the tile layer used for item placement.

0.name: Base Tile Layer
0.description: Places the item on the base tile layer.

1.name: Top Tile Layer
1.description: Places the item on the top tile layer.

fields.name: Player Number
fields.description: The player index used to check whether the item can be collected.

fields.name: X Offset (+1)
fields.description: Offsets the item's X position by one unit.

fields.name: Y Offset (+1)
fields.description: Offsets the item's Y position by one unit.

fields.name: X Offset (+16)
fields.description: Adds an additional 16 units to the item's X position.

fields.name: Y Offset (+16)
fields.description: Adds an additional 16 units to the item's Y position.
